verdict.rationale: The product's own agent is documented to operate autonomously in the browser, and its artifacts include browser recordings, so it can interact with a running web app from the assistant. No evidence shows actual live debugging, such as inspecting console errors, the DOM or network traffic, setting breakpoints, or attaching to a running app. missing for 10: documented live-app debugging features (console/DOM/network inspection, breakpoints or attach-to-process), a dedicated debugging workflow, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug a live running web application directly from my coding assistant

citations.quote: Able to autonomously operate across your editor, terminal, and browser.
Artifacts include rich markdown plans (Implementation Plans), code diffs, architecture diagrams, images, and browser recordings.
